skill.displayName: AI Age Progression Generator - Free Online AI Age Filter – API-powered
skill.summary: AI age progression — transform a portrait to show how the person will look older

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-aging-openapi-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release introducing AI-powered age progression for portrait photos.
- Integrates with WeShop OpenAPI to transform a portrait and visualize age progression.
- Requires a WeShop API key; uses secure HTTPS requests to openapi.weshop.ai.
- Supports custom aging instructions and batch generation (1–16 images).
- Includes endpoints for image upload, run initiation, and run status polling.
